characters.Kai: src/anim/cast.py KAI - lucky red Hawaiian shirt, shorts, flip-flops (bag lost)
characters.Ruth: 71, retired ski instructor, grey hair, teal parka and knit hat, calm and sharp
characters.The man on the cable: red ski patrol jacket, pale, fixed smile, frosted goggles; no breath fog
characters.Patroller Dee: real ski patrol, red jacket, ponytail (Part 3)

scenes.narration: ~Trust him? A man is standing on the cable outside Kai's gondola. Two hundred feet up. In a blizzard. And he's knocking on the glass.
scenes.visual: glove knocking on frosted gondola window, figure on cable, TRUST HIM?

scenes.narration: Kai had worked at the surf shop for six years. He had never seen snow. Then he won a free ski trip.
scenes.visual: Kai at the surf shop holding a winning ticket, happy

scenes.narration: The airline lost his bag. All of it. Except what he was wearing. Shorts. Flip-flops. And his lucky red Hawaiian shirt.
scenes.visual: empty baggage carousel, Kai looking down at his outfit

scenes.narration: Could be worse, Kai said. It was about to get worse.
scenes.visual: Kai smiling in the snow, snow falling on him

scenes.narration: The last gondola of the day. Four thirty. The storm was coming in early.
scenes.visual: base station, gondola cabin rising into grey sky

scenes.narration: One other passenger climbed in. Ruth. Seventy-one years old. Forty winters on this mountain.
scenes.visual: Ruth sits across from Kai inside the cabin

scenes.narration: She looked at his flip-flops. Then at the sky. Son, she said. You picked the wrong day.
scenes.visual: close on Ruth, suspicious, looking at his feet

scenes.narration: Halfway up, the cable shuddered. The lights went out. And the gondola stopped.
scenes.visual: exterior: gondola jolts and stops, cabin light dies

scenes.narration: Two hundred feet of nothing below. Wind slamming the cabin from side to side.
scenes.visual: wide: cabin swinging over a dark drop, storm

scenes.narration: Kai's radio crackled once before it died. Power's out across the mountain. Stay where you are.
Kai looked at the door latch. The next tower was right there. Maybe he could climb...
scenes.visual: Kai's hand reaching for the door latch

scenes.narration: Ruth grabbed his wrist. Don't you dare.
scenes.visual: Ruth close, angry, grabs his wrist

scenes.narration: Here is the rule that keeps people alive. If a lift stops, you stay inside. You never climb out. Rescuers come to you.
scenes.visual: RULE card: STAY INSIDE / NEVER CLIMB OUT / RESCUE COMES TO YOU

scenes.narration: And get off that floor, Ruth said. Metal steals your heat faster than the wind.
scenes.visual: Kai lifts his bare feet off the frosty metal floor

scenes.narration: So they sat on Ruth's backpack, shoulder to shoulder, and waited.
scenes.visual: both huddled together, snow outside the windows

scenes.narration: The temperature dropped. Ten degrees. Then zero.
scenes.visual: thermometer falling, frost creeping across the glass

scenes.narration: Then, at midnight... something knocked on the glass.
A man in a red ski patrol jacket was standing on the cable. Smiling. Open the door, he said. Follow me down.
scenes.visual: figure on the cable outside the window, smiling

scenes.narration: Trust him? Tell me in the comments. Part two is up next.
